# Unifying classes like CombineClasses does.
builder
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
cls a x:i,y:s n=Alpha
cls b x:d,z?:nul n=Beta
cls c y:s,w:i in=Gamma
arr arr a
cls top a:arr,b:b,c:c n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
print
unify 4,5,6 conflate debug
print
gc
print
